input.answer: I'd go with Harel, the "עוקב מדד S&P 500" track. It's the S&P thing my friends talk about, Harel is a big name I know, and its fee is 0.56%, about as low as anything on the list. I nearly went for Harel "מניות" instead because it shows 24.04% over 3 years.

stuck.why: Every company has the same track names over and over (כללי, מניות, S&P 500, משולב סחיר...) with fees between 0.55% and 0.73%, and they all blur together. By screen 7–8 the company name had scrolled off the top and I didn't know whose rows I was looking at.
מניות shows 24.04% over 3 years and S&P shows 13.7%. My gut says the higher one is better, but I came for the S&P, so I hesitated between them.

stuck.where: Rows with 'פחות מ-3 שנים' instead of a return
stuck.why: Many rows have no number at all, just 'less than 3 years'. I couldn't compare them, so I ignored them.
I saw a filter for 'עוקב מדד S&P 500 12' and wanted to tap it, but I just kept scrolling through everything.

'מט"ח' with a percent, e.g. S&P at 99%

findings.what: 143 rows that all look alike, with no recommendation or shortlist. I'd rather close the page than read all of it.
The company name only shows in the group header. After scrolling you can't tell whose rows you're looking at.
Fees only shown as small percents (0.56% vs 0.73%). There's no shekel amount, so the difference feels like nothing.
Lots of rows say 'פחות מ-3 שנים' instead of a number, so I can't compare them.
Big 3-year returns like 24.04% or 26.39% pull your eye with nothing next to them saying what the risk is
Two fee lines per row, and the second is almost always 0%. It's confusing and wastes space.
Jargon in the column headers (חשיפה למט"ח, לפני דמי ניהול) and little rings with no label next to them
findings.where: Table header and the ring charts
